text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...Alright.

...The summer training camp is drawing to a close.
Symboli Kris S has shown magnificent, tremendous growth during this camp...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks to you—it turned into a great training camp.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Once we get back... to the academy... I'll count on you... again.
choice_data_list: Let's iron out every detail we can in the time we have left!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...For the sake of absolute victory—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Want a drink?
choice_data_list: Thanks! Don't mind if I do.

text_block_list.text: Quenching our thirst together, Symboli Kris S and I watched the sunset with a sense of accomplishment.
And so, the summer training camp came to an end in the best possible way, but—
Like a tempest shaking an entire generation, the news arrived without warning.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: —W-What... did you just say...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh hehâ Is it truly so difficult to comprehend?
Then allow me to grant you a revelation once moreâ

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Hear me! As of this very moment, in accordance with my soul, I have decided to conceal myself in the shadows, stepping away from the stage where the stars clash!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: For ages to come, deep—yet ever close—I shall raise a cup and watch the passage of time.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
D-Does that mean... could it be—
You're going on a long hiatus?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Revelations mutate into thousands of forms depending on the recipient, at times sparking great conflicts over their true meaning...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—I shall forgive and embrace that chaos!
Shatter the words however you please!
Farewell! To the world, and to my beloved observers!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Beyond the intoxication, behold my undying light—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"Tanino Gimlet-san!!
Please talk to us a little more!!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: A word for the fans as well, please!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh...! Hahahaha!!
Bwaaaahahahaha!!!

"And so, Tanino Gimlet,
all too suddenly, vanished
from the front lines of racing—"
